5095393383781.sourceDescription:
This artificial Christmas tree features ultra-realistic PE foliage combined with dense inner PVC tips to create an exceptionally full and natural silhouette. The rich greenery delivers an authentic evergreen look that elevates your holiday decor with a lifelike appearance reminiscent of a real forest.

The design incorporates a generous profile with layered 2080 tips, bringing traditional holiday majesty and festive warmth to any indoor space. Its thick greenery fills the room effectively, capturing timeless charm while serving as a versatile seasonal accent for living rooms or offices.

A pre-attached hinge mechanism allows branches to fall into place automatically, significantly reducing setup time compared to traditional trees. Pre-moulded PE tips maintain their shape consistently, ensuring you spend less time shaping and more time enjoying the festive season with family and friends.

Both the PE and PVC foliage are crafted from flame-retardant materials, providing complete peace of mind during cosy winter gatherings. This safety feature is supported by a strong metal base, delivering reliable fire safety and stability for households with young children or pets present.

The product measures 210cm in height with a width and depth of 140cm, offering substantial presence without overwhelming smaller rooms. It blends seamlessly with existing festive decorations, infusing an authentic forest touch into your layout while maintaining a practical and safe environment for annual celebrations.

Pre-attached hinge mechanism allows branches to fall into place automatically for quick setup.
Crafted from flame-retardant materials to ensure safety during festive winter gatherings.
Strong metal base provides reliable stability and supports the tree's substantial presence.

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Stated size: 8cm. Quantity: 12 pack.
Reusable design allows for long-term festive decoration and easy storage between seasons.
Vibrant decorative baubles add colour and detail to Christmas trees or seasonal displays.
Generous 12-pack quantity provides ample ornaments for coordinating a complete festive look.
Classic 8cm spherical shape offers a versatile finishing touch for any holiday arrangement.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 12x Christmas Baubles
Hanger included

5060801258081.sourceDescription: STUNNING CHRISTMAS TREE BOW TOPPER: Make your Christmas tree the centrepiece of your home with this large red velvet bow tree topper. The rich festive red velour fabric and generous proportions create a dramatic, full look that elevates any tree display. Use it as a classic Christmas tree topper decoration or drape the long tassels down the front of the tree for a truly eye-catching festive statement. VERSATILE CHRISTMAS DECORATION BOW FOR DOORS AND MORE: This premium red bow is perfect for far more than just tree topping. Hang it on your front door as a bold festive welcome, drape it over a stair banister, fix it to a wreath, garland or mantelpiece, or use it to dress a fireplace. The strong hanging loop makes installation quick and easy, so you can transform any space into a festive showpiece in moments. PLIABLE WIRE FRAME FOR PERFECT SHAPING EVERY TIME: Unlike stiff or floppy Christmas bows, this large red velvet decoration bow features a fully pliable wire frame throughout the bow loops and tassels. Bend, sculpt and reshape it to achieve your ideal style, from full and dramatic to soft and elegant. The velour finish holds its shape beautifully and the deep red colour stays vivid display after display throughout the festive season. DIMENSIONS AND WHAT IS IN THE BOX: The bow section measures approximately 35cm wide and 22cm tall, with tassels approximately 128cm long and around 11.5cm wide, giving an overall length of approximately 150cm. You receive one large red velvet Christmas bow. The pliable wire frame runs throughout and a fabric hanging loop is sewn securely at the back of the bow for easy hanging. CARE, STORAGE AND GIFTING: To keep the bow looking its best, store it flat or hanging in a cool, dry place between seasons. Gently reshape the wire frame loops and tassels each year to restore its full appearance. The bow arrives folded and can be quickly shaped on arrival.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The multicoloured finish and glass construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Double Sided Design
The two sided design gives you a choice of usable surfaces or presentation. Turn the item to the side that suits the intended arrangement.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

5056797097681.sourceDescription:
Welcome guests with a beautiful glow this Christmas with this pre-lit micro LED 2D wreath from MySmartBuy. Densely packed micro LEDs trace the classic wreath shape, creating a crisp, sparkling ring of light that looks stunning on a front door or wall. Choose from 50cm or 70cm sizes, with up to 1200 LEDs, in warm white for a cosy traditional glow or cool white for a frosty, contemporary look. A hanging point makes it easy to put up on doors, walls, windows and fences, and it comes with a storage box so it stays in perfect condition between seasons. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. A lit wreath is the perfect finishing touch for the front of the house, giving visitors a warm welcome and making your home look instantly festive from the street. Pair it with matching lights along the porch or a garland around the door frame for a coordinated look. A beautiful way to welcome guests this Christmas, it can be brought out year after year to make your home look instantly festive. At a glance: 2D micro LED wreath | 50cm or 70cm | up to 1200 LEDs | warm white or cool white | hanging point | storage box | 5m lead cable | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | indoor and outdoor use.

INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE : Perfect for front doors, walls, windows and fences.

5056463974681.sourceDescription:
Bring elegant festive styling to your home with this 60cm Gold LED Christmas Door Wreath. Designed to create a welcoming seasonal display, the decorative arrangement features gold baubles, glittered leaves, berry sprays, pinecones and a large coordinating bow for a rich Christmas appearance. Integrated warm white LED lights illuminate the wreath, highlighting the decorative details and creating a soft glow during darker evenings. Two selectable lighting modes allow you to choose between steady illumination and a flashing effect, making it easy to adjust the appearance according to your preferred Christmas atmosphere. The wreath operates using three AA batteries, providing flexible placement without requiring a nearby mains socket or trailing power cable. Batteries are not supplied. Measuring approximately 60cm across, the generous circular design creates an attractive focal point for suitable doors, walls, windows, hallways and living spaces. Ideal for coordinating with gold Christmas tree decorations, festive garlands and seasonal ornaments, this illuminated wreath combines traditional festive elements with an elegant gold colour scheme.
ELEGANT GOLD CHRISTMAS DESIGN: Decorated with shimmering gold baubles, glittered leaves, decorative berry sprays, natural-looking pinecones and a large festive bow, creating a coordinated seasonal appearance for traditional and contemporary Christmas interiors.
WARM WHITE LED ILLUMINATION: Integrated warm white lights shine throughout the wreath to create a soft welcoming glow, highlighting the gold ornaments and decorative foliage while adding attractive illumination to evening Christmas displays.
TWO SELECTABLE LIGHTING MODES: Choose between steady illumination for a continuous warm glow or a flashing light effect for a more eye-catching festive display, allowing the wreath to complement different seasonal decorating preferences.
BATTERY OPERATED FOR FLEXIBLE DISPLAY: Powered by 3 x AA batteries, allowing convenient positioning on suitable doors, walls, windows and indoor display areas without requiring a nearby mains socket or trailing electrical cable. Batteries are not included.
GENEROUS 60CM DECORATIVE WREATH: Measuring approximately 60cm across, this large circular Christmas decoration creates a noticeable festive focal point for entrance areas, hallways, living rooms and other suitable seasonal home displays.

Create a winter-woodland feel with this Frosted Berry & Pinecone Pre-Lit Christmas Garland. Available in 180cm and 270cm sizes, it’s beautifully illuminated by LEDs to add a magical glow to doors, banisters, windowsills, and fireplaces.

COLOUR SWITCH LEDS & LIGHT EFFECTS: Switch from warm white to multi-coloured LEDs to set the perfect festive mood. From gentle fades and twinkles to colour-changing displays, choose from a variety of light effects, with a memory chip remembering your last setting.

LOOPS FOR EASY HANGING: Durable metal loops on both ends make the garland easy to hang around doors, banisters, fireplaces, and more. Coloured green to blend with the foliage, the loops also make it easy to tie more than one garland together for a longer display.

Colour Switch LEDs: Warm white and multi-colour
Timer Function: 6 hours on / 18 hours off

Built-In Hanging Design for Effortless Installation
Fitted with a solid plastic backing panel and pre-drilled hanging holes, this wreath can be easily mounted on doors, windows, fireplaces and walls. The reliable fixing structure ensures stable and secure placement throughout the entire Christmas holiday period.
Multi-Purpose Festive Home Decoration
With a versatile 40cm classic size, this wreath is perfect for decorating front entryways, fireplace mantels, windows and walls. Suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use, it effortlessly fills every corner of your home with rich Christmas festive cheer.
Fully Assembled Ready-To-Hang Design
This Christmas wreath comes fully pre-assembled with no complex setup required. Simply unwrap and hang it up to instantly upgrade your home’s festive look. Boasting a timeless classic style, it complements various decorative themes, including traditional and modern farmhouse Christmas decor.

With eight stunning display modes, it invites festive creativity through its modern flexibility, powered simply via USB connectivity. Requiring easy assembly involving two people with a screwdriver, it promises a swift transformation from a simple start to a substantial festive centerpiece. The tree's elegance lies in its detail, from the lifelike tips mimicking natural foliage to the secure metal base providing stability and grandeur throughout the holidays. Whether as a delightful living room focal point or a warming decor piece on patios shielded from the elements, this tree can mold to environments while maintaining a fresh seasonal spirit. Users will appreciate its adaptability, with instructions guiding efficient setup and maintenance, allowing homeowners to focus on creating lasting festive memories. Ideal for anyone seeking contemporary style with traditional holiday values, its combination of materials, color, and design ensures a cherished and personalized addition to any holiday home landscape.

Create a focal point

Coordinate colour and texture

Style around the occasion

Give the detail room to show

Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

5075660347081.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and steel construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Solar Powered
The solar powered design uses daylight for its energy supply. Position the panel where it can receive suitable daylight and keep the panel surface clear.

Warm White Light
Warm white illumination gives the display a softer colour tone. It can be paired with surrounding decorative lighting to create a coordinated appearance in the intended setting.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Steel. Colour: White. Stated size: 50 cm. Quantity: 2 pack.
Solar powered operation harnesses daylight energy for convenient, wire-free festive illumination.
Warm white LED lighting creates a soft, inviting glow that enhances your Christmas display.
Durable steel construction with a water-resistant finish ensures longevity in outdoor settings.
Compact 50 cm design allows flexible placement to create a focal point in any arrangement.
Guarantee - 1 month
Comes with 2x Christmas decorations
Suitable for Indoor & outdoor use

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.
